verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a managed live-streaming service. Its only automation-related evidence is that EventBridge rules can trigger on IVS events, which is a host-platform (AWS EventBridge) capability, not an IVS feature. Nothing in the pack shows IVS itself offering versioning, review, or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
